sentences.en: Please replace the empty ink jet cartridge in the printer.
sentences.zh: 请更换打印机里的空墨盒。

sentences.en: I noticed the sale prices were written in red ink.
sentences.zh: 我注意到销售价格是用红墨水写的。

sentences.en: The boy spilled the ink, but he didn't mean to.
sentences.zh: 男孩把墨水洒了，但他不是故意的。
